spec_match.rationale: Uses the explainer's exact structure — menubar > submenu > (menuitem + menulist), nested submenu, fieldset checkable=single/multiple with legend, defaultchecked, disabled — and reads the checked/defaultChecked/disabled IDL members defined in html_menu_item_element.idl, including the exclusive-uncheck behavior implemented in HTMLFieldSetElement::UpdateMenuItemCheckableExclusivity.

interactive.rationale: Read-IDL and set-checked buttons drive a live state table in every browser; the parser inspector feeds real markup through innerHTML and reports per-element constructors; on flagged browsers the menubar itself logs activation and checked events.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index promises the full menubar with checkable groups and an IDL inspector; the page delivers those plus the parser inspector.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers nested submenu, disabled item, radio exclusivity via IDL write, defaultchecked seeding, and the honest IDL-missing branch on unflagged browsers.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite's defaultchecked-seeding and single-exclusivity assertions encode exactly what this page demonstrates; verified to fail honestly on Chromium 141, but the pass branch needs a MenuElements build.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 verified: fallback banner shown, native markup hidden (no broken inline soup), IDL inspector reports IDL missing for all 12 items, set-checked reports the honest negative, parser inspector reports 4x HTMLUnknownElement, console clean, 0px overflow at true 360; menubar keyboard model and checked events are unverifiable here.

telemetry_health.rationale: menubar-state-read asserts the IDL read, menubar-idl-exclusivity asserts the radio contract, and the fallback branches report separately (state-fallback-honest, idl-set-fallback-honest).

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only, AA contrast (muted grey only on paper for de-emphasis text, charcoal/black for content), no button colour overrides, table scrolls in .table-scroll.

accessibility.rationale: aria-label on the menubar and tables, aria-live polite status outputs, capture-phase checked listener keeps the visible table in sync with state, and the unsupported branch explains itself in text rather than hiding silently.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at 1280x1800 and at a true 360px viewport (same-origin iframe harness): 0px horizontal overflow after adding code{overflow-wrap:anywhere} for the long IDL token run in the lede, full-width stacked buttons, state table scrolls internally.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible menu keyboard navigation roving tabindex aria menubar pattern
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: State changes need non-visual equivalents; controls need accessible names.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Checked-state changes render into a labelled table plus aria-live status text; every control is a native labelled button.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel narrow mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Long unbreakable inline tokens must wrap (overflow-wrap) and grid items need min-width:0.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The lede's checked/defaultChecked/disabled code run measured 364px wide at 360; fixed with code{overflow-wrap:anywhere} and .lab>*{min-width:0}, re-measured to 0 overflow.

guidanceConsulted.query: popover anchored dropdown positioning dismissal focus
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Overlay menus should come from the popover machinery rather than hand-positioned DOM.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The native menulists rely entirely on the implicit popover behavior; the page adds no positioning JS, and on unsupported browsers the markup is hidden rather than approximated.

openQuestions.title: Exercise the live menubar keyboard model and checked event on a flagged 143+ build
openQuestions.detail: Arrow-key traversal, single tab stop, Enter/Space open, Escape focus-return, the checked event (the page listens in capture phase since bubbling is unconfirmed), and safe-triangle submenu hover cannot be verified on Chromium 141. Run the page in Chrome Canary 143+ with MenuElements and record the real behavior; adjust the checked-event wiring if it turns out to bubble.

openQuestions.title: Show the checkable state visually inside the open menu
openQuestions.detail: On a flagged build, verify the ::checkmark pseudo-element renders for checked items and consider a short styling example (menuitem:checked / ::checkmark) once observable.

summary: Full application menubar with nested submenu and checkable fieldsets, an IDL state inspector that stays honest on unflagged browsers, and a universal parser inspector. Verified on headless Chromium 141 (fallback branch, clean console, 0 overflow at true 360); the flagged-path keyboard/checked behavior is sourced from Chromium implementation code and queued for verification on a 143+ build.
